  - Adaptive, not a constant slowdown. Normal speed while there's audio in hand; ease down smoothly to 0.9× as the buffer drains, and to 0.85× in the worst case; recover smoothly. Changes are gradual, so you hear a slightly more deliberate delivery at times, never a lurch.

    faster than real time, it will almost never engage.
  - Pitch-preserving:
